name: Shiva Temple
town_description: Tamenglong is the headquarters town of Tamenglong district in the hills of western Manipur, a land of dense forests, waterfalls (the Barak waterfalls) and the Zeilad lake. The district is predominantly inhabited by Rongmei/Zeliangrong Naga tribes and is overwhelmingly Christian; documented Hindu shrines are few and mostly generic. Tamenglong town is about 185 km by road from Imphal.

travel.airport: Imphal International Airport (IMF), roughly 150-185 km by winding hill road from Tamenglong (verify).
travel.railway: No railway station in the district; nearest railheads are Dimapur (Nagaland) and Silchar (Assam), both 150+ km away (verify).
travel.road: Tamenglong is linked to Imphal by hill roads (NH-37 corridor via Khongsang); expect long travel times (verify).

visitor_information.best_time: October to March, the dry, cool season in the Manipur hills.
